time.sr: Prosečna izrada traje oko 3 dana. Tačan rok dogovaramo pre početka rada, u zavisnosti od paketa i obima posla. Na upit odgovaramo u roku od 24h.
time.en: An average build takes about 3 days. We agree on the exact deadline before we start, depending on the package and scope. We reply to inquiries within 24h.

maintenance.sr:
Domen, hosting, SSL sertifikat, redovan backup i tehnička podrška su uvek uključeni.
Starter (29 €/mes): i manje izmene sadržaja, fotografija i informacija. Professional (59 €/mes): + dodatna podrška i održavanje naprednih funkcionalnosti. Business (99 €/mes): + izmene sadržaja i održavanje booking sistema. Premium (149 €/mes): kompletna tehnička briga, ažuriranja, booking i izmene sadržaja.
maintenance.en:
Domain, hosting, SSL certificate, regular backups and technical support are always included.
Starter (€29/mo): plus minor content, photo and info updates. Professional (€59/mo): + extra support and maintenance of advanced features. Business (€99/mo): + content updates and booking system maintenance. Premium (€149/mo): complete technical care, updates, booking and content updates.

faq.sr: Cena izrade sajta kreće od 499 € za Starter paket, a web shop od 849 €. Uz to ide mesečno održavanje od 29 € (domen, hosting, SSL, backup i podrška).
faq.en: Websites start at €499 (Starter) and online stores at €849. Monthly maintenance starts at €29 and covers domain, hosting, SSL, backup and support.

faq.sr: Prosečna izrada traje oko 3 dana. Tačan rok dogovaramo pre početka rada, u zavisnosti od paketa i obima posla.
faq.en: An average build takes about 3 days. We agree on the exact deadline before we start, depending on the package and scope.

faq.sr: Domen, hosting, SSL sertifikat, redovan backup i tehnička podrška. U zavisnosti od paketa i izmene sadržaja i održavanje booking sistema.
faq.en: Domain, hosting, SSL certificate, regular backups and technical support. Depending on the package, also content updates and booking system maintenance.

faq.sr: Da. Domen i hosting su uključeni u mesečno održavanje – ne morate ništa da zakupljujete sami.
faq.en: Yes. Domain and hosting are included in monthly maintenance – you do not need to buy anything yourself.

faq.sr: Da, u Business i Premium paketu dobijate CMS – jednostavan panel za izmenu tekstova, slika i cena. U ostalim paketima izmene radimo mi.
faq.en: Yes, Business and Premium include a CMS – a simple panel for editing text, images and prices. In other packages we make the changes for you.

faq.sr: Da. Svaki sajt je optimizovan za Google – od osnovnog SEO-a u Starter paketu do napredne SEO strukture, Google Analytics i Search Console u većim paketima.
faq.en: Yes. Every site is optimized for Google – from basic SEO in Starter to an advanced SEO structure, Google Analytics and Search Console in bigger packages.

faq.sr: Ne. Provizije payment provajdera i banke nisu uključene u cenu paketa i plaćaju se direktno njima.
faq.en: No. Payment provider and bank fees are not included in the package price and are paid directly to them.

faq.sr: Da. Dodatne funkcionalnosti po meri se dodatno ugovaraju – opišite nam u upitu šta vam treba.
faq.en: Yes. Custom features can be added by separate agreement – describe what you need in your inquiry.

info.en: Product entry: the product count applies to products for which the client provides photos, prices and descriptions.

info.sr: Dodatni proizvodi: proizvodi preko limita paketa se dodatno naplaćuju.
info.en: Extra products: products over the package limit are charged extra.

info.sr: Ažuriranje proizvoda: manje izmene cena, slika, opisa i akcija uključene su u mesečno održavanje.
info.en: Product updates: minor changes to prices, images, descriptions and promotions are included in monthly maintenance.

info.sr: Masovne izmene: masovne izmene proizvoda i cena dogovaraju se posebno.
info.en: Bulk changes: bulk product and price changes are agreed separately.

info.sr: Plaćanja: provizije payment provajdera, banke i licence nisu uključene u cenu paketa.
info.en: Payments: payment provider fees, bank fees and licences are not included in the package price.

info.sr: Domen i hosting su uključeni u mesečno održavanje.
info.en: Domain and hosting are included in monthly maintenance.

info.sr: Funkcionalnosti koje nisu u paketu mogu se dodatno ugovoriti.
info.en: Features not included in the package can be added by separate agreement.
